$why: Nine retry prefixes, one per seam, each prepended to a prompt whose first answer was unusable.
They were written out again at every seam that needed one, and they had already diverged: some
say the response was empty, some that it was unparseable, some that the previous attempt
ONE BODY PER SEAM, not one shared body — because what a retry must say genuinely differs by
what went wrong, and flattening them would tell an agent its output was malformed when in fact
it had written nothing. Together in one document, the nine are now diffable against each other.
description: What an agent is told when its first answer could not be used, by seam.

bodies.story_recovery_analyst:
RETRY (attempt 2): Your previous response was empty or unparseable. Respond with ONLY the JSON: {"restructure": true/false, "reason": "...", "new_acs": [...]}.

__PROMPT__
bodies.hybrid_prephase_coordinator:
RETRY (attempt 2): The previous invocation produced no output. Use your tools to read the PRD, write coordination messages to agent-messages.jsonl, and write the summary log now.

__COORD_PROMPT__
bodies.skills_coordinator:
RETRY (attempt 2): Previous attempt did not update profiles.json. Read __AGENT_PROFILES_FILE__, find the exact flagged note, and rewrite it now.

__SC_PROMPT__
bodies.tools_coordinator:
RETRY (attempt 2): Previous fix left __TC_TOOL__.sh syntactically broken. bash -n reports: __TC_BN_ERR__. Fix the syntax error and write the corrected script back now.

__TC_PROMPT__
bodies.phase_assessment:
RETRY (attempt 2): Your previous response was not valid JSON in the required shape. Emit ONLY the JSON object now.

__ASSESSMENT_PROMPT__
bodies.lint_gate_analyst:
RETRY (attempt 2): Your previous response was empty. Read the lint log at __LINT_LOG__, identify the failing file and story, and emit ONLY the JSON output.

__LINT_FINDING_PROMPT__
bodies.lint_remediator:
RETRY (attempt 2): Your previous response was empty or missing the 'new_acs' field. Emit ONLY the JSON: {"story_id":"...","new_acs":["..."]}.

__LINT_AC_PROMPT__
bodies.gate_finding_analyst:
RETRY (attempt 2): Your previous response was empty. Use ReadFile to read the gate log at __GLOG__, extract the finding, and emit ONLY the JSON output.

__FINDING_PROMPT__
bodies.ac_remediator:
RETRY (attempt 2): Your previous response was empty or missing the 'acs' field. Emit ONLY the JSON: {"acs_added": N, "acs": ["..."]}.

__AC_PROMPT__
